text:
Predicates:
Suck(x) ::: x sucks.
Vacuum(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
HouseholdAppliance(x) ::: x is a household appliance.
Plunger(x) ::: x is a plunger.
Vampire(x) ::: x is a vampire.
Space(x) ::: x is space.

Premises:
Plunger(plunger) → Suck(plunger) ::: Plungers suck.
Vacuum(vacuum) → Suck(vacuum) ::: Vacuums suck.
Vampire(vampire) → Suck(vampire) ::: Vampires suck.
Space(space) ∧ Vacuum(space) ::: Space is a vacuum.
HouseholdAppliance(duster) ∧ ¬Suck(duster) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.

Conclusion:
∀x (HouseholdAppliance(x) → Suck(x)) ::: If something is a household appliance, it sucks.
